title: Psalm 62 (Septuagint) = Psalm 63 (KJV)
description: Psalm 62 in the Septuagint numbering (Psalm 63 in the KJV). Both the manuscript page scan AND the Greek text are taken directly from Codex Sinaiticus (4th century AD) via the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). The Greek transcription preserves the actual uncial forms, lunate sigma, nomina sacra abbreviations, and lectional marks of the manuscript. Library folio: 103. English translation verbatim from the King James Version (1611, public domain) via bible-api.com.
introduction:
This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library, with the manuscript text drawn directly from the same source as the scan:

  1. Manuscript scan: The actual folio of Codex Sinaiticus containing this passage, from the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). Library folio reference: 103.
  2. Original text: The verbatim transcription of the Sinaiticus manuscript from the Codex Sinaiticus Project, preserving uncial forms, lunate sigma, nomina sacra (e.g. ⟨θϲ⟩ = θεός), and scribal marks. Nomina sacra are shown in angle brackets to indicate the manuscript's sacred-name abbreviations.
  3. English translation: The King James Version (1611), retrieved verbatim from the public-domain bible-api.com endpoint.

Numbering: Codex Sinaiticus follows the Septuagint Psalter, in which this is Psalm 62. In the Hebrew and King James numbering the same psalm is Psalm 63. Greek verse numbers follow the Septuagint, which counts the superscription as verse 1; English verse numbers follow the KJV, so they run 1 behind the Greek. The Greek and English in each section are the same words of the same psalm.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>ψαλμοϲ τω δαυειδ εν τω ειναι αυτον εν τη ερημω τηϲ ϊουδαιαϲ <sup>2</sup>ο θϲ ο θϲ μου προϲ ϲε ορθριζω εδιψηϲεν ϲοι η ψυχη μου ποϲαπλωϲ ϲοι η ϲαρξ μου εν γη ερημω και αβατω και ανυδρω <sup>3</sup>ουτωϲ εν τω αγιω ωφθην ϲοι του ϊδειν την δυναμιν ϲου και την δοξαν ϲου <sup>4</sup>οτι κρειϲϲον το ελεοϲ ϲου ϋπερ ζωαϲ τα χειλη μου επαινεϲουϲιν ϲε <sup>5</sup>ουτωϲ ευλογηϲω ϲε εν τη ζωη μου εν τω ονοματι ϲου αρω ταϲ χειραϲ μου
translation.text:
<sup>1</sup>O God, thou
art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is; <sup>2</sup>To see thy power and thy glory, so
as I have seen thee in the sanctuary. <sup>3</sup>Because thy lovingkindness
is better than life, my lips shall praise thee. <sup>4</sup>Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

translation.original_text: <sup>6</sup>ωϲει ϲτεατοϲ και πιοτητοϲ εμπληϲθειη η ψυχη μου και χειλη αγαλλιαϲεωϲ αινεϲει το ονομα ϲου<sup>7</sup>ει εμνημονευον ϲου επι τηϲ ϲτρωμνηϲ μου εν τοιϲ ορθροιϲ εμελετων ειϲ ϲε <sup>8</sup>οτι εγενηθηϲ βοηθοϲ μου και εν τη ϲκεπη των πτερυγων ϲου αγαλλιαϲομαι <sup>9</sup>εκολληθη η ψυχη μου οπιϲω ϲου εμου αντελαβετο η δεξια ϲου <sup>10</sup>αυτοι δε ειϲ ματην εζητηϲαν την ψυχην μου ειϲελευϲονται ειϲ τα κατωτατα τηϲ γηϲ
translation.text:
<sup>5</sup>My soul shall be satisfied as
with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise
thee with joyful lips: <sup>6</sup>When I remember thee upon my bed,
and meditate on thee in the
night watches. <sup>7</sup>Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice. <sup>8</sup>My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me. <sup>9</sup>But those
that seek my soul, to destroy
it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

translation.original_text: <sup>11</sup>μεριδεϲ αλωπεκων εϲονται <sup>12</sup>ο δε βαϲιλευϲ ευφρανθηϲεται επι τω κω επαινεϲθηϲεται παϲ ο ομνυων εν αυτω οτι ενεφραγη ϲτομα λαλουντων αδικα
translation.text: <sup>10</sup>They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes. <sup>11</sup>But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

verification.section_folios_note: Each section links to the specific folio(s) containing its verses, resolved per verse via the Codex Sinaiticus Project page index.
